description.narrative: "Her Internet was created to respond to the increased rates of online harassment/extortion, privacy breaches, surveillance, and digital censorship targeted towards young women in Uganda. It is an emerging LGBT, young woman-led organization working to promote and advocate for the digital rights and safety/security needs of women living at the margins of society. The women include sexual and gender minorities, sex workers, women human rights defenders, refugees, trafficking survivors, and women living in hard to reach areas. The Equality Fund grant will support HER INTERNET's core operational mission costs including salaries and transport needs and the following activities: -Support Her Internet's delivery of digital literacy and digital safety/security resources for women, girls, and trans*people to build their digital capacity and awareness. This strengthens the protection and agency of feminist actors and activists to navigate the digital world for the realization of their rights. -Support the implementation of Her Internet's organizational priorities in its newly-formed direction. -Identified capacity building priorities for the staff, including communications, financial reporting and grantwriting -Website design and development for the organisation. DigiSec Dialogues targeting individuals from the LBQT/SW communities."
